# sheets-sync

> Schema-driven one-way sync of keyed records into a Google Sheets tab: pure diff plan with A1 ranges, typed cell serialisation and a port for the API Python package `trysac-sheets-sync`, import name `sheets_sync`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
